original_title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake Trilogy Will Incorporate Settings and Stories From All Spin-Offs – Director
summary_en: The ambitious Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is set to become the ultimate compilation of the iconic RPG's universe. Director Naoki Hamaguchi has confirmed that the upcoming final part will incorporate elements from every spin-off title, promising a fresh, comprehensive experience for fans.
ai_analysis: This confirms Square Enix's commitment to a unified FF7 narrative, potentially bridging decades of lore and satisfying long-time fans who’ve followed the entire Compilation.

en.title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake Trilogy Will Weave in ALL Spin-Off Stories
en.summary: The ambitious Final Fantasy 7 Remake trilogy is set to become the ultimate compilation of the iconic RPG's universe. Director Naoki Hamaguchi has confirmed that the upcoming final part will incorporate elements from every spin-off title, promising a fresh, comprehensive experience for fans.
en.body:
The **Final Fantasy 7 Remake** project is evolving into something far grander than a mere retelling of the original PlayStation classic. Director **Naoki Hamaguchi** has revealed that the upcoming trilogy will fully embrace the entirety of the **Final Fantasy 7** universe, drawing inspiration and narrative threads from all its spin-off titles.

During a Q&A session, Hamaguchi elaborated on the ambitious scope of the remake series. "This **Final Fantasy 7 Remake** series is not simply a recreation of the original work, but rather, our goal is to create a single, new **Final Fantasy 7** that incorporates the settings and concepts of all the previous spin-off titles, such as **Advent Children**, **Dirge of Cerberus**, and **Crisis Core**," he stated. This means players can expect characters and plot points from these beloved side stories to be seamlessly integrated into the main narrative, offering a cohesive and expanded vision of **Midgar** and beyond.

## A Unified Compilation Universe

The intention behind this expansive approach is to craft a definitive **Final Fantasy 7** experience that honors its rich history. Hamaguchi mentioned the fan-favorite character **Cissnei** from **Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7**, whose appearance in **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** was met with much excitement. "The appearance of **Cissnei** and the inclusion of **Dirge of Cerberus** Soldiers in the DLC, all have that meaning," he explained, underscoring how these inclusions are part of a larger plan to weave the Compilation's lore together. This approach aims to satisfy the dedicated fanbases of each individual spin-off, ensuring that long-standing characters and their stories are given their due in this new narrative.

## What This Means for the Final Chapter

This expansive narrative design will undoubtedly carry over into the as-yet-unnamed third installment of the **Final Fantasy 7 Remake** trilogy. Hamaguchi assured fans that "for the last entry, there will be characters that have appeared in the various **FF7** compilation games that I think will be there." The inclusion of characters beyond the original **FF7** roster is not just fan service; it's integral to building a complete and resonant **Final Fantasy 7** saga. The team's goal is to create a singular, epic narrative that respects and expands upon the decades of storytelling that have defined this beloved franchise.

## The Road to Revelation

With **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** now available, the focus shifts to the concluding chapter of the **Remake** project. While specific details about the third game's release date are still emerging, indications point towards a 2026 launch window. Square Enix has previously indicated that the trilogy will eventually release on multiple platforms, a move that broadens accessibility for this monumental undertaking. Fans eagerly await further announcements as **Square Enix** continues to build towards what promises to be the most comprehensive **Final Fantasy 7** story ever told.

tr.title: Final Fantasy 7 Remake Üçlemesi Tüm Spin-Off Hikayelerini Bir Araya Getirecek
tr.summary: Ambisyonlu Final Fantasy 7 Remake üçlemesi, ikonik RPG'nin evreninin en kapsamlı derlemesi haline geliyor. Yönetmen Naoki Hamaguchi, yaklaşan son bölümün tüm spin-off başlıklarından unsurları içereceğini onayladı ve böylece fanatiklere taze, kapsamlı bir deneyim vaat ediyor. Bu, oyuncuların tüm Final Fantasy 7 evrenini tek bir hikayede deneyimlemesine olanak tanıyacak.
tr.body:
## Kapsamlı Bir Derleme Evreni
Final Fantasy 7 Remake projesi, orijinal PlayStation klasiginin basit bir yeniden anlatımından çok daha büyük bir şeye dönüşüyor. Yönetmen Naoki Hamaguchi, yaklaşan üçlemenin tüm Final Fantasy 7 evrenini kapsayacağını, tüm spin-off başlıklarından ilham ve hikaye ipliklerini alacaklarını açıkladı. 
Bu, oyuncuların **Advent Children**, **Dirge of Cerberus** ve **Crisis Core** gibi sevilen yan hikayelerden karakter ve olayların ana hikayeye sorunsuz bir şekilde entegre edilmesini bekleyebilecekleri anlamına geliyor. 
## Birleştirilmiş Bir Evren
Bu geniş yaklaşımın ardındaki amaç, zengin tarihine saygı duyarak tanımlayıcı bir Final Fantasy 7 deneyimi yaratmak. Hamaguchi, **Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7**'den sevilen karakter **Cissnei**'nin **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth**'teki görünümünden bahsetti ve "Bu karakterlerin ve **Dirge of Cerberus** askerlerinin görünümü, daha büyük bir planın parçası" dedi. 
Bu approach, her bir spin-off'un sadık fanatiklerini memnun etmeyi amaçlıyor ve uzun süredir var olan karakterlerin ve hikayelerinin yeni anlatıda hak ettikleri yeri almasını sağlıyor. 
## Son Bölüm için Ne Anlama Geliyor
Bu geniş anlatı tasarımı, şüphesiz ki **Final Fantasy 7 Remake** üçlemesinin henüz adlandırılmamış üçüncü bölümüne de taşınacak. Hamaguchi, son girişin "çeşitli **FF7** derleme oyunlarında görünen karakterleri içereceğini" söyledi. 
Orijinal **FF7** kadrosunun ötesindeki karakterlerin dahil edilmesi, sadece fan hizmetinin ötesinde, eksiksiz ve etkili bir **Final Fantasy 7** sagasını inşa etmenin önemli bir parçasıdır. 
## Açıklamanın Yolu
**Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** artık mevcut iken, odak son **Remake** projesi bölümüne kayıyor. Üçüncü oyunun yayın tarihine ilişkin específik detaylar henüz ortaya çıkarken, 2026 lansman penceresi işaret ediliyor. Square Enix, üçlemenin sonunda birden fazla platformda yayınlanacağını daha önce belirtmişti, bu da bu büyük girişimin erişilebilirliğini genişletiyor. 
Fanatikler, **Square Enix**'in vaat edilen en kapsamlı **Final Fantasy 7** hikayesini anlatmaya devam ederken daha fazla açıklamayı dört gözle bekliyor.

es.title: La trilogía de Final Fantasy 7 Remake: una compilación épica
es.summary: La ambiciosa trilogía de Final Fantasy 7 Remake se convertirá en la recopilación definitiva del universo de este icónico RPG. El director Naoki Hamaguchi ha confirmado que la última parte incorporará elementos de todos los títulos spin-off, prometiendo una experiencia fresca y completa para los fanáticos.
es.body:
El proyecto de **Final Fantasy 7 Remake** está evolucionando hacia algo mucho más grande que una simple relectura del clásico de PlayStation. El director **Naoki Hamaguchi** ha revelado que la trilogía incorporará la totalidad del universo de **Final Fantasy 7**, inspirándose en los títulos spin-off y sus hilos narrativos.

Durante una sesión de preguntas y respuestas, Hamaguchi elaboró sobre el alcance ambicioso de la serie de remakes. > "Esta serie de **Final Fantasy 7 Remake** no es simplemente una recreación de la obra original, sino que nuestro objetivo es crear un nuevo **Final Fantasy 7** que incorpore los escenarios y conceptos de todos los títulos spin-off anteriores, como **Advent Children**, **Dirge of Cerberus** y **Crisis Core**", explicó. Esto significa que los jugadores pueden esperar que los personajes y puntos de la trama de estas historias secundarias se integren de manera fluida en la narrativa principal, ofreciendo una visión cohesiva y expandida de **Midgar** y más allá.

## Una compilación unificada del universo
El objetivo detrás de este enfoque expansivo es crear una experiencia definitiva de **Final Fantasy 7** que honre su rica historia. Hamaguchi mencionó al personaje favorito de los fanáticos **Cissnei** de **Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7**, cuya aparición en **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** fue recibida con gran emoción. > "La aparición de **Cissnei** y la inclusión de los soldados de **Dirge of Cerberus** en el DLC, todo tiene ese significado", explicó, subrayando cómo estas inclusiones son parte de un plan más grande para entretejer la lore de la compilación. Este enfoque apunta a satisfacer a las bases de fanáticos dedicados de cada título spin-off individual, asegurando que los personajes y sus historias reciban el reconocimiento que merecen en esta nueva narrativa.

## Lo que esto significa para el capítulo final
Este diseño narrativo expansivo sin duda se llevará al tercer y último capítulo de la trilogía de **Final Fantasy 7 Remake**. Hamaguchi aseguró a los fanáticos que "para la última entrega, habrá personajes que han aparecido en los diversos juegos de la compilación de **FF7** que creo que estarán allí". La inclusión de personajes más allá del elenco original de **FF7** no es solo un servicio a los fanáticos; es integral para construir una narrativa épica y resonante de **Final Fantasy 7**. El objetivo del equipo es crear una narrativa singular y épica que respete y expanda la década de historias que han definido a esta querida franquicia.

## El camino a la revelación
Con **Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth** ahora disponible, la atención se centra en el capítulo conclusivo del proyecto de **Remake**. Aunque los detalles específicos sobre la fecha de lanzamiento del tercer juego aún están emergiendo, las indicaciones apuntan hacia una ventana de lanzamiento de 2026. Square Enix ha indicado previamente que la trilogía eventualmente se lanzará en múltiples plataformas, lo que amplía la accesibilidad para este monumental esfuerzo. Los fanáticos esperan ansiosos más anuncios a medida que **Square Enix** continúa construyendo hacia lo que promete ser la historia más completa de **Final Fantasy 7** jamás contada.

content_raw: While Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is set to feature many iconic scenes and characters from the original Final Fantasy 7 , director Naoki Hamaguchi has teased that there will also be characters from spin-offs of the original showing up. In a Q&A session in Shanghai, as caught by Genki_JPN, Hamaguchi was asked about whether Crisis Core: Final Fantasy 7 ’s Cissnei, who we last saw in Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth , will be showing up in Revelation . “Well, at this time it’s best not to say whether Cissnei will appear or not, but there is one thing I can tell you,” replied Hamaguchi. “This Final Fantasy 7 Remake series is not simply a recreation of the original work, but rather, our goal is to create a single, new Final Fantasy 7 that incorporates the settings and concepts of all the previous spin-off titles, such as Advent Children , Dirge of Cerberus , and Crisis Core . Therefore, the appearance of Cissnei and the inclusion of Dirge of Cerberus Soldiers in the DLC, all have that meaning.” “So, since that concept will of course carry over into Revelation as well, not limited to Cissnei, for the last entry, there will be characters that have appeared in the various FF7 compilation games that I think will be there, and each of these characters has a large and dedicated fanbase, so we want to create a work that can satisfy the feelings of those people.” He went on to talk about how Cissnei has a lot of fans. “Whenever I talk to the media or fans, they very often ask me if Cissnei will appear or say they like Cissnei,” he laughed. Fans of the original Final Fantasy 7 and its spin-offs shouldn’t find this too surprising, since we’ve seen many references to these spin-offs and even cross-media stories like novels throughout the trilogy so far. Final Fantasy 7 Remake , for instance, featured an appearance of Leslie Kyle during its Wall Market sections. This character made his first appearance in Final Fantasy VII The Kids Are Alright: A Turks Side Story – a story published in Japan back in 2011. The same game also features the main antagonists of Dirge of Cerberus – Weiss and Nero – as VR missions in its Episode INTERmission DLC, which eventually got included with the base game as Final Fantasy 7 Remake Intergrade . Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth saw similar inclusions. Along with the appearance of Cissnei, the title also included smaller references to other stories in the same universe, such as Tifa having a cat. Earlier this month, Hamaguchi also spoke about how he had played through Final Fantasy 7 Revelation around 40 times, and how a certain emotional scene always ended up leaving him in tears . Final Fantasy 7 Revelation is being developed for PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch 2, and will be coming out in Spring 2027. For more details about why Square Enix decided to call the third entry in the trilogy Revelation , take a look at what Hamaguchi had to say about potentially calling it Resolve .
